interactive.description: Normal user-facing chat after workspace bootstrap is complete.
interactive.memory: MEMORY.md is injected; memory_search reads MEMORY.md and memory/*.md

isolated-cron.memory: not injected; memory_search still reads MEMORY.md and memory/*.md

heartbeat-full.description: Heartbeat with the default full context mode.
heartbeat-full.memory: MEMORY.md is injected; memory_search reads MEMORY.md and memory/*.md

heartbeat-light.conversation_history: main/configured session unless isolatedSession is enabled
heartbeat-light.memory: not injected; runtime memory tools remain policy-controlled

bootstrap-pending.description: Primary interactive run before workspace setup is complete.
bootstrap-pending.memory: MEMORY.md is injected when present and indexed by memory_search

subagent.memory: not injected; runtime tool policy decides memory access

skills.ownership: OpenClaw discovers the catalog; the agent reads selected bodies

tools.ownership: OpenClaw assembles schemas and enforces policy
tools.clawock_policy: never narrow the runtime tool set implicitly

backends.ownership: OpenClaw decides how each model backend receives skills and tools
backends.runtime_plugin_note: A runtime-plugin backend receives the same resolved skill snapshot out of band (claude-cli gets a materialized --plugin-dir plugin) and drops the file/exec tools the CLI already owns. Its prompt report therefore shows an empty skills catalog and a narrower tool set with no capability lost, so those fields cannot be compared against a system-prompt backend.
backends.channel_family: the session-key segment after the agent id; jobs and peers inside one family share a tool dialect, and the message tool schema differs between families
